channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Stanford Scientists Turn Cancer Driver Into Kill Switch
item.description: A Stanford-designed molecule turns a lymphoma-promoting protein against cancer cells, triggering their own self-destruct machinery.

item.title: New Feeding Method Brings Out Zoo Lions' Wild Behavior
item.description: Giving zoo lions whole carcasses on a feast-and-fast schedule appears to encourage more natural behavior, with the lions feeding nearly three times longer.

item.title: Physicists find evidence of unusual superconductivity
item.description: Researchers report evidence of an unusual superconducting state in uranium ditelluride, where electron pairs form into ripples.

item.title: Drug target may block brain inflammation in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's
item.description: Blocking the P2X7 receptor reduced inflammation in human brain tissue, suggesting a possible new treatment approach for neurological conditions.
